sweep.title: Parametric sweep
sweep.intro: Generate N simulation folders varying ONE parameter (flux, mass or temporal history) while keeping the rest of the current base file fixed. Each folder includes its inp.5 and a copy of the base folder contents (libraries and auxiliary files).
sweep.val_ok: The base file is valid: you can define the sweep.
sweep.val_bad: The base file has {n} validation error(s); fix them before generating the sweep.
sweep.root_hint: The per-simulation subfolders will be created here.
sweep.base_hint: Its contents are copied in full to every subfolder.
sweep.browse_err: Could not open the folder picker.
sweep.desc_ph: e.g. flux sweep for TeO2, T_irr = 24 h
sweep.flux_expl: XNORM scales all fluxes keeping the SHAPE of the spectrum; the rest of the file (composition, geometry, temporal history) stays frozen. Only valid if the real scenario does not change the spectrum shape.
sweep.flux_values_ph_phi_generic: total flux [n/cm²·s] (load a base file to see examples)
sweep.warn_flux_mode_confusion_phi: Values {list} produce an XNORM outside the usual [1e-3, 1e3] range. Did you enter factors in target-flux mode?
sweep.warn_flux_mode_confusion_xnorm: Values {list} are outside the usual XNORM factor range [1e-3, 1e3]. Did you enter absolute fluxes in factor mode?
sweep.mass_expl: Volume and compound are fixed, so the packing density of the target varies. The zone structure (INUCL) is preserved; only the XCOMP of the target zone changes. Not available with INPT = 2 (isotopes).
sweep.mass_inpt2: The base file uses INPT = 2 (isotopes); the mass sweep is not available.
sweep.time_expl: Each row defines a simulation with its irradiation and/or cooling phases. Empty fields keep the base file phase. NOTTS (Block #11) is synced automatically per simulation.
sweep.spectrum_expl: Import external neutron spectra (IAEA CONDERC format) and vary the SHAPE of the spectrum passed to COLLAPS. Block #3 (total flux) stays the same across all simulations, so the comparison between spectra is at equal total flux by construction. After each COLLAPS run, FLUX.inf is recorded as a verifier (never as an input data source).
sweep.spectrum_phiref_hint: Prefilled with Block #3 of the base file. If you edit it, the same value is applied to all simulations.
sweep.spectrum_empty: No spectrum has been loaded yet.
sweep.spectrum_erange_hint: E_min–E_max of the file. An E_min in the keV range betrays a partial-range spectrum (e.g. EXFOR origin): to compare reactors, the lower boundary must reach the thermal region.
sweep.spectrum_order_confirm: Autodetected order: visually confirm it matches the file.
sweep.spectrum_warn_directional: Spectrum less specified than the library: group expansion is the least reliable operation.
sweep.err_bad_phiref: φ_ref must be a number greater than 0.
sweep.warn_no_base: The base folder does not exist or is not accessible.
sweep.warn_base_inp5: The base folder contains an inp.5: it will be replaced by the generated one in each simulation.
sweep.warn_collisions: These subfolders already exist: {list}. You will be asked to confirm overwriting.
sweep.warn_disk: The estimated disk cost ({size}) exceeds 2 GB.
sweep.confirm_many: You are about to generate {n} simulations. Continue?
sweep.confirm_overwrite: Some subfolders already exist. Overwrite their contents?
sweep.err_no_values: There are no values to sweep.
sweep.err_no_rows: Add at least one temporal simulation row.
sweep.err_no_atomic: Could not load the atomic data library.
sweep.err_preview_first: Preview the sweep before generating it.
sweep.run_existing_hint: Select the root folder of an already generated sweep (with its sweep_manifest.json) to run it.
sweep.run_no_root: Enter the sweep root folder before running it.

b1.izmax_hint: Non-zero elements in the Transition Matrix

b4.irest_1: 1 — Read initial composition from UNIT 37 (omits Block #5)
b4.irest_hint: When IREST = 1, Block #5 is not included in the input file.

b9.xnorm_hint: Flux scaling factor. Recommended: 1.0. Negative → prints neutron transmutation rates.

b2.card1_h: Card #1 — XRR — Interval limits / Zone volumes
b2.yzt_hint: JM+1 interval limits in 2nd dimension (cm). Omit if JM = 0 (1D or 3D).
b2.card3_h: Card #3 — MA — Zone assignment per spatial interval
b2.ma_hint: IM values (1D) or IM×JM values (2D). Material zone assigned to each spatial interval, left-to-right, bottom-to-top.
b2.card4_h: Card #4 — NUCZO — Number of initial species per zone
b2.nuczo_izm_mismatch: NUCZO has {n} values but IZM = {izm}: they must match.
b2.card5_h: Card #5 — ISOZO — Number of feed species per zone
b2.isozo_hint: Number of continuously fed elements/isotopes per zone (Block #6). Omit if INFD = 0.
b2.card6_h: Card #6 — EGRP — Gamma energy group boundaries (MeV)
b2.egrp_hint: NOGG+1 gamma energy group boundaries in MeV, in decreasing order. Omit if NOGG = 0.
b2.card7_h: Card #7 — CUTOFF — Truncation thresholds for output tables
b2.cutoff_desc: One threshold per table type. Isotopes below the threshold at time step MSTAR are omitted from the 'most important isotopes' tables. Set 0 to disable. Only types 1–4 are active in the current ACAB version.
b2.card8_h: Card #8 — NTO — Output table selection (18 flags)
b2.nto_desc: 18 flags (0/1) for the 18 output tables. Only relevant when JTO = 1 (Block #1). Types 5 and 6 are inactive and must remain 0.

b3.card1_h: Card #1 — FLUX — Multigroup scalar neutron/gamma fluxes
b3.iflu_warn: IFLU ≠ 1 in Block #1 — this block will not be written to the output file.

b5.zone_alert: Zones are generated automatically from NUCZO (Block #2). Change the values there to add, remove or resize zones. Previously entered data is preserved when changing the number of species.
b5.empty_msg: Define zones in NUCZO (Block #2) to enable composition editing.

b6.infd_alert: This block is only required when INFD > 0 (Block #1). Feed rates are expressed in g-atoms (moles) per second.
b6.zone_alert: Zones are generated automatically from ISOZO (Block #2). Only zones with ISOZO[i] ≠ 0 create a Block #6 section.
b6.empty_msg: Set INFD > 0 (Block #1) and define ISOZO (Block #2) to activate continuous feed.

b11.nmult_hint: Write inventory to UNIT 48 every NMULT cycles. 0 = disabled.

b14.iunc_warn: This block is only active when IUNC = 1 in Block #1. If IUNC changes to a value other than 1, this section will be disabled.
b14.ntimes_hint: Total number of times of interest.
b14.ncyu_hint: Cycles with times of interest. 0 if NOPUL = 0.
b14.nnucu_hint: Number of nuclides with atom density uncertainty.

val.v18d: Block #14 ICYU: expected NCYU = {ncyu} values. Got {got}.
val.v18e: Block #14 ITSU: expected NOTTS = {notts} values. Got {got}.
val.v18f: Block #14 ITIMEU: expected rows = non-zero ITSU count = {exp}. Got {got}.
val.v18g: Block #14 INUCU: expected NNUCU = {nnucu} values. Got {got}.

val.v24b: Block #5 zone {z}: INPT=2 (isotopes) but all identifiers look like elements (multiples of 10000). Check INPT in Block #1 or the identifiers.

val.v25c: Blocks #7/#8 set {s}: expected MOUT = {mout} time values, found {got}.
val.v25d: Blocks #7/#8 set {s}: it is the last set, so NGO must be 0.
val.v25e: Blocks #7/#8 set {s}: NGO = 0 in an intermediate set; ACAB would ignore the following sets.
val.v25f: Blocks #7/#8 set {s}: MSUB = {msub} does not point to the last step of the previous set (previous MOUT = {prev}).

b5calc.err_no_lib: Could not load the atomic data library (static/data/atomic_data.json).
b5calc.err_no_density: No library density for this formula (neither as a compound nor as a pure element): cannot compute V = m/ρ. Enter the volume manually.
b5calc.err_mass: Enter a valid mass (> 0 g) before computing V = m/ρ.
b5calc.warn_xrr: Warning: the entered volume ({v} cm³) does not match the XRR component of zone {z} ({xrr} cm³) in Block #2 (for IGE=4, XRR is each zone's volume). Fix one of the two to keep them consistent.
b5calc.toast_nuczo: Zone {z} NUCZO adjusted to {n} to fit the computed elements.
b5calc.note: Validated formula (INPT=1): XCOMPi = (m·wi/Mi)·NA/(10²⁴·V) in atoms/barn·cm. For INPT=3: XCOMPi = m·wi/V in g/cc. With IGE=4, V must match the zone's XRR component (Block #2). Note: ACAB expands elemental identifiers using the isotopic abundances of its DECAY.dat library, which may differ from modern (CIAAW) abundances; if the isotopic composition is critical, check the abundances of the DECAY.dat in use.
